prompts.prompt: Original literary editorial illustration, fine black ink on clean white paper, sparse light grey hatching, generous negative space. Monochrome only, no sepia or coloured fills. Believable anatomy, hands, weight and supported objects. No letters, labels, speech balloons, borders or readable text. No identifiable real person or documentary reconstruction. A gently humorous imagined queen sits in a plain chair, wearing a simple unornamented crown and loose unpatterned clothing with no identifiable historical or regional costume. She holds one small flower lightly on her open palm, elbow supported on the chair arm, and looks at it with a mildly theatrical raised eyebrow and small smile. Her other hand is open in a relaxed questioning gesture. The flower remains a small real flower, never an enormous weight. Keep her posture comfortable and the setting almost empty; no servants, throne, palace, physical distress or observers mocking her.
prompts.caption: An imagined queen considers the weight of a single flower.
prompts.alt: A seated figure wearing a simple crown looks at a small flower resting on her open palm.

prompts.prompt: Original literary editorial illustration, fine black ink on clean white paper, sparse light grey hatching, generous negative space. Monochrome only, no sepia or coloured fills. Believable anatomy, hands, weight and supported objects. No letters, labels, speech balloons, borders or readable text. No identifiable real person or documentary reconstruction. An adult in ordinary loose shirt and trousers sits sideways on a low stable bench beside a medium-sized dog. The adult rests one hand gently on the dog’s upper back, leaning forward slightly with a quiet surprised smile. The dog stands with all four paws on the ground, lifts its head toward the adult’s near cheek and extends a small tongue just short of it. Show a clear side view: dog muzzle, adult face and hand remain distinct, no merged anatomy. The other hand rests on the bench. No aggression, restraint, children, food, training equipment or crowded background.
prompts.caption: An imagined affectionate encounter, closer than expected.
prompts.alt: A seated adult rests a hand on a dog’s back as the dog lifts its muzzle toward the adult’s cheek.

prompts.prompt: Original literary editorial illustration, fine black ink on clean white paper, sparse light grey hatching, generous negative space. Monochrome only, no sepia or coloured fills. Believable anatomy, hands, weight and supported objects. No letters, labels, speech balloons, borders or readable text. No identifiable real person or documentary reconstruction. Two small unbordered sequential vignettes on one white page, using the same plainly dressed adult organizer, identical small table and noticeboard in both. In the first, viewed obliquely from the side, the organizer unpins and lifts away one single sheet from the noticeboard beside a tidy stack of blank forms. In the second, the same organizer pins that sheet back onto the same board while another adult watches with a calm questioning expression. The sheet has only a few faint non-letter lines and is recognizably the same size; no readable instructions, arrows, numbers or labels. Keep the gestures and paper handling simple, one sheet in each scene, with no duplicated hands or floating pin. Sparse background; no ritual, healer costume or supernatural imagery.
prompts.caption: An imagined organizer removes a guide, then presents its return as a solution.
prompts.alt: Two views show the same organizer taking a sheet from a noticeboard and putting it back beside a stack of forms.
